dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,65)>Hee hee... Guess what I just saw? <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>A star, whizzing through
the sky like WHOOSH!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,4)><$emotion(2,65)>Adivinha o que acabei de ver? <$voicel(2,7)><$emotion(2,39)>Uma estrela, que zuniu
O céu como Whoosh!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Oooh, nice.
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,4)><$motion(1,806)>Boa.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)>Yeah, and I made a wish on it! <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,816)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,8)>I love stars, so I wished that
I could see one up close!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,8)><$emotion(2,27)>Sim, e eu fiz um pedido! <$voicel(2,9)><$motion(2,816)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,8)>Eu amo estrelas, por isso desejei que
Eu podia ver um de perto!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>Wow! What happened, then?
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(1,8)><$motion(1,803)><$facial(1,4)><$comeff(1,10)>O que aconteceu então?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>And then I ran into you! And you look like a star! <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>So I’m
super happy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,14)>E depois encontrei-te e pareces uma estrela! <$voicel(2,10)><$motionoff(2,804)><$facial(2,4)><$comeff(2,21)>Assim, eu sou
Super feliz!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,6)>Hehehe... I’m happy I ran into you, too! <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)>It’s pretty rare to
see a shooting star. <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,6)>You don’t see many around here, huh?<$kfacial(1)>
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,4)><$emotion(1,6)>Hehehe... Estou feliz por ter encontrado você também! <$voicel(1,6)><$motion(1,802)><$facial(1,2)><$comeff(1,14)>É muito raro para
ver uma estrela cadente. <$voicel(1,10)><$comeff(1,6)>Você não vê muitos por aqui, hein?<$kfacial(1)>

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,29)>Oh... Really? ’Cause the whizzy-whooshy one I saw was
right over there!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,3)><$emotion(2,29)>Oh... A sério? Porque o que eu vi foi
Ali mesmo!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,65)><$facial(1,14)>Over there? <$voicel(1,2)>Hang on a minute... <$voicel(1,4)>That might not have been
a shooting star... <$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>I think that was me on a walk!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,8)><$emotion(1,65)><$facial(1,14)>Ali? <$voicel(1,2)>Espera um minuto... <$voicel(1,4)>Isso pode não ter sido...
Uma estrela cadente... <$voicel(1,10)><$facial(1,13)><$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,806)>Acho que fui eu a caminhar!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,5)><$facial(1,2)>Huh?! Wait, now that you mention it, maybe it really
WAS you! <$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,39)><$facial(1,4)>This kinda feels like fate!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(2,5)><$emotion(2,5)><$facial(1,2)>Espera, agora que falas nisso, talvez seja mesmo...
ERA você! <$voicel(2,10)><$emotion(2,39)><$facial(1,4)>Isto parece o destino!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Pardon me, <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(272)></color>...

dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>O que é que precisas?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>I wanted to say that the flower on your head has such a
lovely sheen. It looks quite healthy!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Eu queria dizer que a flor na sua cabeça tem um tal
Parece bastante saudável!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,9)>...Ya think so? Gettin’ compliments makes my tummy feel
all fluttery. Heh.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,659)><$voicel(2,9)>...Ya pensa assim? Obtin’ elogios faz a minha barriga sentir
Está todo agitado.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,8)>Gracious! Your flower just moved. It’s almost as if <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,7)>it shares
in your joy, <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(272)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,8)>Gracioso! Sua flor apenas se moveu. É quase como se <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,668)><$voicel(1,7)>Acções
em sua alegria, <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(272)>.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,6)>Say what?! Naw, I don’t believe that for a minute.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,6)>Dizer o quê?! Não, eu não acredito que por um minuto.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>It just moved again! It really does seem to mirror your
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,2)>emotions, doesn’t it?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Ele apenas se moveu novamente! Realmente parece espelhar o seu
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)><$facial(1,2)>emoções, não é?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Hmmmmmm...
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>So, uh...does that mean that everyone can see how I’m
feelin’ all the time? Plain as day?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,3)>Hmmmmmm...
<$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Então, uh... isso significa que todos podem ver como eu sou
sentindo’ o tempo todo? Simples como o dia?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>That may well be the case.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Pode muito bem ser o caso.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,7)>Well, that’s embarrassin’. So that time I was feelin’ a
certain kinda way... And that other time... And—
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Y’know what? I’m just gonna stop thinkin’ about it!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Ugh. Now I’m feelin’ kinda weird. Guess I’ll just sleep it
off! <$comeff(2,15)>Good night, <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(121)>.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,5)><$motion(2,665)><$voicel(2,7)>Bem, isso é embaraçoso’. Então, daquela vez eu estava sentindo’ um
De certa maneira... e daquela outra vez... e...
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,3)>Você sabe o quê? Eu vou apenas parar de pensar sobre isso!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Ugh. Agora eu estou me sentindo ' meio estranho. Acho que eu vou dormir
Fora! <$comeff(2,15)>Boa noite. <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(121)>.

dialogues.pt_br: <$motion(2,619)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,3)>Meu Deus, a tua flor...

dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Aquela festa que tivemos foi muito divertida!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Yooo! Everybody was dancin’ and vibin’—it was
AWESOME. We gotta do it again sometime!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Yooo! Todo mundo estava dançando’ e vibin’ - era
Temos de repetir um dia destes!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Yes, we must! If we keep throwing such fun parties, <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>I think
the humans will take notice and return someday!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Se continuarmos a dar festas tão divertidas, <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Eu acho.
Os humanos vão notar e voltar um dia!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Yeah! Then, when the humans are back, we can get ’em to
make lots and lots of <$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>new music for us to vibe to!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Então, quando os humanos voltarem, podemos levá - los a
fazer lotes e lotes de <$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>música nova para nós vibrar!

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh, what a wonderful thought! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>I’m sure they’ll come up
with all manner of new recipes, too!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,6)>Oh, que pensamento maravilhoso! <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Tenho certeza que eles vão subir
com todo o tipo de receitas novas, também!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Yooo! That’d be PERFECT! It’d make our parties SO much
more awesome!<$cdef(27)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Hope you’ll help us out too,<$cdef(27)> !

<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Yooo! Isso seria perfeito! Faria nossas festas tanto
Mais fantástico!<$cdef(27)><$lookat(2,1,0)><$lookat(1,1,0)>
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Espero que você vai nos ajudar também,<$cdef(27)> !

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I can’t wait to make merry with you,
<$cdef(27)>, sweetie!

<$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Mal posso esperar para me divertir com você,
<$cdef(27)>Querida!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Yeeeaaah! Your vibes are IMMACULATE as usual,
<$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>As tuas vibrações estão imaculadas, como sempre.
<$cdef(27)>!

<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(2,2)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>And I’ll keep sharpening my culinary skills so I can fix up
a fabulous feast when that day comes!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(2,2)><$facial(1,2)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>E eu vou continuar afiando minhas habilidades culinárias para que eu possa consertar
Um banquete fabuloso quando esse dia chegar!

<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>I totally respect your commitment to awesome food, <$cdef(27)>Chef!
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>I kinda wanna eat your yummy food even if we’re not
partyin’!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>You bet they are! And not just any clouds, either! <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>These
can fire thunderbo—
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Pode apostar que sim, e não qualquer nuvem. <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,3)>Estes
pode disparar trovão--

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,11)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Whoa, whoa, WHOA! What’re you doin’?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,11)><$facial(2,13)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Whoa, whoa, Whoa! O que você está fazendo?!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh, your clouds were cracklin’ with electricity, and well...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>I just wanted a li’l jolt!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Oh, suas nuvens estavam rachando’ com eletricidade, e bem...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,8)>Eu só queria um li’l jolt!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,22)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,9)>Okaaay, but...that doesn’t mean ya can just PECK at ’em!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,22)><$facial(2,7)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,9)>Okaaay, mas... isso não significa que você pode simplesmente PECK em ’em!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,6)>Yeesh, you’re no fun... I just figured since they look so
much like thunderclouds, <$voicel(1,3)>they must pack a nice zap.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,6)>Yeesh, você não é divertido ... Eu só pensei que desde que eles parecem tão
como nuvens de trovões, <$voicel(1,3)>Têm de fazer um bom zap.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,4)>Sure, sure, you could probably call ’em thunderclouds...
But STILL, ya can’t just—
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,4)>Claro, claro, você provavelmente poderia chamá-los de nuvens de trovões...
Mas ainda assim, você não pode simplesmente...

Você! Vamos!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Sorry, pal, my bad! Somethin’ just came over me, y’know?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>I won’t do it again...probably.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Desculpe, amigo, meu erro! Algo’ apenas veio sobre mim, você sabe?
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu não vou fazer isso de novo...Provavelmente.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>I dunno if I believe ya, bud... Do somethin’ like that
again, <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>and I’m gonna zap you with my lightning!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Eu não sei se eu acredito em você, amigo... Faça algo assim
Outra vez, <$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>e eu vou zap você com o meu raio!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Wait, you will? Awesome! Come on, pal, zap it to me!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,7)>Vamos lá, amigo, dá-me isso!

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>It’s so shiny and, like, super AWESOME! <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m gonna polish

dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>É tão brilhante e, como, super incrível! <$comeff(1,21)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Eu vou polir
e o tesouro para sempre!

dialogues.en: <$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,12)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>Ummm... It’s my—
dialogues.pt_br: <$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,12)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,1)>É o meu...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Yep! This is gonna be my most treasured treasure! Oh, uh...
I got a bit worked up there, huh? <$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Hehe. My bad!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>What were you sayin’,<$cdef(27)> <$cname(268)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Este vai ser o meu tesouro mais precioso!
Fiquei um pouco agitado lá em cima, huh? <$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Foi mal!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,5)>O que é que disseste?<$cdef(27)> <$cname(268)>?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>Sooo... That might be the coin I juuust dropped...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>Então... essa pode ser a moeda que eu deixei cair...

<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Whaaat? Seriously?! I’m sorry, yo! <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>Guess I gotta give it
back to ya, then!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>Whaaat? Sério?!! Desculpe, yo! <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,6)>Acho que tenho de o dar.
De volta a ti, então!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh... Are you suuure? You were so haaappy about it.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,5)>Estavas tão feliz com isso.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Yeah, I’ll be fine! I mean, of course I want the coin, but I
can’t steal somethin’ <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,9)>that belongs to you, <$cdef(27)><$cname(268)>!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Sim, eu vou ficar bem! Quero dizer, é claro que eu quero a moeda, mas eu
não pode roubar alguma coisa’ <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,9)>que te pertence, <$cdef(27)><$cname(268)>!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,3)>OK...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Heyyy, it looks like the coin I dropped is over here...
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>So I guess the one yooouuu picked up was a different one.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,7)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,3)>Está bem...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Parece que a moeda que deixei cair está aqui...
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,7)>Então, acho que o que você pegou foi outro.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>Whoa! Seriously?! So that means...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,8)>A sério, isso significa...

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,8)>Yeahhh. That one’s yooouuurs to keep.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,8)>Sim. Esse é o que você quer manter.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Yoooooo! Awesome! I’m so happy!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,13)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Ioooooo! Impressionante! Estou tão feliz!

dialogues.en: <$comcan(1)><$facial(2,2)><$voicev(2,8,80)><$textsize(0)>Heheheee. Take good caaare of it...</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(1)><$facial(2,2)><$voicev(2,8,80)><$textsize(0)>Tira-lhe uma boa dose...</textsize>

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>*sigh*... I wish I knew what to do about this...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Queria saber o que fazer sobre isto.

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>What’s the matter? You’re lookin’ a li’l glum there.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Qual é o problema? Você está olhando’ um li’l mal lá.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh, hey... It’s just, uh... Do I seem unapproachable or
whatever to you?
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,2)>I kinda feel like the other Pokémon are avoidin’ me...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Oh, ei... é só que... pareço inapreensível ou...
O que é que te interessa?
<$comeff(2,17)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,2)>Eu meio que sinto que o outro Pokémon estão me evitando...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>What? You too?! I’ve been havin’ the same issue, to tell ya
the truth!
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>I could be havin’ a great conversation with someone, <$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>and
as soon as I get to the real fun stuff, they up ’n’ hightail
it outta there!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>O que? Você também?! Eu tenho tido’ o mesmo problema, para dizer-lhe
A verdade!
<$comeff(1,14)><$voicel(1,3)>Eu poderia estar tendo uma ótima conversa com alguém, <$comeff(1,17)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,2)>e
assim que eu chegar ao material divertido real, eles subir ’n’ fasttail
Sai daí!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Yeah! Same here! That’s so weird, isn’t it?! <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>How come no
one sticks around to hear all I’ve got to say...?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>Sim! O mesmo aqui! Isso é tão estranho, não é?! <$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>Por que não?
um fica para ouvir tudo o que tenho a dizer...?

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>I commiserate, I do! I really do! Just when I’m ’bout to get
to the good part, <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>suddenly nobody’s interested anymore!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,8)>Eu lamento, eu faço! Eu realmente faço! Justo quando eu estou prestes a obter
para a parte boa, <$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>de repente, ninguém mais está interessado!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>But there’s one Pokémon who always sticks around till the
end of our stories: our bud <$cdef(27)> here!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Mas há um Pokémon que fica sempre por perto até o
fim de nossas histórias: nosso broto <$cdef(27)> Aqui!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Hear! Hear! What a pal!
<$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(0,4)>Hm? You OK there, <$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>You’re sweatin’ an awful lot...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Que amigo!
<$facial(2,2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,2)><$voicel(1,6)><$comeff(0,4)>está bem aí? <$cdef(27)>?
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Você está suando muito...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Uh-oh! I got so swept up in the moment here <$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>that I let out
a little too much steam!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$facial(2,1)><$voicel(2,6)>Fiquei tão arrasada neste momento. <$comeff(2,4)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,4)>que eu deixei sair
Um pouco de vapor a mais!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Y’know what—me too! I’ve been scatterin’ coal everywhere
over the course o’ this rivetin’ discussion!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Você sabe o que -- eu também! Eu tenho espalhado carvão 'em todos os lugares
ao longo do curso de ‘ esta discussão rebitin’!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh... Do you think this might be the reason why everyone
avoids us?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,2)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,4)>Achas que esta pode ser a razão pela qual todos
Evita-nos?

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Y’know what... You may be onto somethin’! But I dunno if
now’s the best time to try ’n’ figure it out!
<$cdef(27)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>’s startin’ to look a li’l faint!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,6)>Você sabe o que... Você pode estar em alguma coisa! Mas eu não sei se
agora é a melhor hora para tentar ‘n’ descobrir!
<$cdef(27)><$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,8)>'está começando a parecer um li'l desmaiar!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,4)>Sorry, <$cdef(27)>! We’ll back off, bud! Just
hang
in there!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,4)><$comeff(1,4)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,4)>Desculpa. <$cdef(27)>Vamos recuar, amigo! Apenas
pendurar
Ali dentro!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>You’re so stylish, <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(44)>! You’ve got
an
accessory
on
your
head
vine
and everything!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Você é tão elegante, <$cdef(27)><$cname;0(44)>Você tem

Pokémon! <$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,4)><$voicel(1,9)>Pode mudar o que sentes.
<$cdef(27)><$cname;0(80)>!

<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Heh... Perhaps you are right.
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,10)>I suppose I could watch over <$cdef(27)>
and

others
should
my

dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)>Talvez tenhas razão.
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,10)>Acho que posso ficar de olho. <$cdef(27)>
e

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>Don’t overthink it! Just get out there and have FUN!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,10)>Não pense demais! Basta ir lá e se divertir!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)><$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster! Your hammer is SOOO cool! But, uh, isn’t it
hard to smack stuff with it? <$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Why’d you shape it like that?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)><$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster! Seu martelo é tão legal! Mas, uh, não é
É difícil bater nas coisas com ele? <$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>Por que você moldou assim?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Let’s see... I started cuttin’ up stuff and stickin’ it on my
hammer... Tinkerin’ with it to make it easier to use.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>And over time, my hammer ended up lookin’ like this!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Vamos ver... Eu comecei a cortar as coisas e ficar com elas na minha
martelo... Tinkerin’ com ele para torná-lo mais fácil de usar.
<$comeff(1,9)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>E com o tempo, meu martelo acabou ficando assim!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>So...does that mean you DON’T use it while battling?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,8)>Então... isso significa que você não o usa enquanto luta?

dialogues.en: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Sure don’t! This thing right here is for helpin’ others.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Claro que não! Esta coisa aqui é para ajudar os outros.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>Helping...others?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,6)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>Ajudar... outros?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Yeah! Like, roofin’ someone’s home or reinforcin’ cave
walls so the whole thing doesn’t collapse, y’know?
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>My li’l helper here’s always workin’ hard so folks can live
more comfortably.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Sim! Como, telhado em casa de alguém ou reinforcina ' caverna
paredes para que a coisa toda não desmoronar, você sabe?
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,10)>Meu ajudante li’l aqui está sempre trabalhando’ duro para que as pessoas possam viver
mais confortavelmente.

dialogues.en: <$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster</color>... You’re so thoughtful!
dialogues.pt_br: <$facial(1,2)><$comeff(2,3)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,661)><$voicel(2,6)><$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster</color>... Você é tão atencioso!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Nah, I’m just givin’ back.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Folks’ve shared their food with me when I was hungry, or
lemme crash with them when I needed a place to sleep...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>I’m here today thanks to everyone who’s helped me out!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Não, eu só estou dando de volta.
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>As pessoas compartilharam sua comida comigo quando eu estava com fome, ou
Deixa-me dormir com eles quando precisava de um sítio para dormir...
<$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,7)>Estou aqui hoje graças a todos que me ajudaram!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Whoa... That’s so COOL! *sniffle* <$cdef(27)>T-Tinkmaster, I wanna be
JUST like you!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,21)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Isso é tão fixe! <$cdef(27)>T- TinkmasterEu quero ser
Tal como tu!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Heh, you’re makin’ me blush a little.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Well, if you’re interested, I’m happy to teach ya how to
build stuff.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Heh, você está me fazendo corar um pouco.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Bem, se você está interessado, eu estou feliz em ensiná-lo a
Construir coisas.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Really?! YESSS! I want you to teach me everything you
know, <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,13)><$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,10)>Quero que me ensines tudo o que és.
Sabe, <$cdef(27)>Tinkmaster!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Huh? Hey, <$cdef(27)><$cname(342)></color>! Your wings are a little dirty, y’know!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Olá. <$cdef(27)><$cname(342)></color>! Suas asas estão um pouco sujas, você sabe!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Oh yeah? Probably ’cause I was just playing around in
some mud.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,5)>Provavelmente porque estava só a brincar em
Um pouco de lama.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)>Did you wash yourself off after playing, though?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas lavaste-te depois de jogares?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,8)>Duh! I dove into the water to rinse off! <$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,10)>Nothing like the
ol’ splash-n-shine.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,9)><$voicel(2,8)>Mergulhei na água para enxaguar! <$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,10)>Nada como o
slash-n-shine.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,4)>What? That’s all?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,4)>O quê? Isso é tudo?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>Yep! That’s always how I get clean.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,10)>Sim! É sempre assim que eu fico limpo.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,7)>But that’s not enough! You have to actually PREEN your
feathers! <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Look! There’s still mud all over your wings!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas isso não é suficiente! Você tem que realmente PREEN seu
Penas! <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Olhe! Ainda há lama em todas as suas asas!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>What? No way, that’s too much work!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>O quê? De jeito nenhum, isso é muito trabalho!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>C’mon, don’t be lazy! You’ve GOTTA clean yourself!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,7)>Vamos, não seja preguiçoso! Você tem que limpar-se!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>OK, OK, fine! I’ll do it properly...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Está bem, está bem, eu faço-o como deve ser...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,2)><$textsize(0)>...Later.</textsize>
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,17)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,2)><$textsize(0)>...Mais tarde.</textsize>

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,10)>Not later, NOW!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,22)><$motion(1,662)><$voicel(1,10)>Não mais tarde, AGORA!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Hey, <$cdef(27)><$cname(338)>! How do ya feel about a fun li’l outing today?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>We could fly together somewhere far, far away!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Olá. <$cdef(27)><$cname(338)>! Como você se sente sobre um passeio li'l divertido hoje?
<$comeff(1,3)><$motionoff(1,804)><$voicel(1,8)>Podíamos voar juntos para um lugar muito, muito longe!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, what a nice idea! I’d love to!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, que boa idéia! Eu adoraria!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Heck yeah!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>You ready? ’Cause I’m ready! Let’s zip along the wind and
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>zoom all over the place!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,10)>Claro que sim!
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Você está pronto? 'Porque eu estou pronto! Vamos fechar ao longo do vento e
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Faz zoom por todo o lado!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>What? Actually, on second thought...<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,2)>I think I’ll stay back.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,6)>Na verdade, pensando melhor...<$comeff(2,7)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,2)>Acho que vou ficar para trás.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,2)>Huh? But why?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,11)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,2)>Mas por quê?!!!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>When I go for a flight, I like to take my time and hum a
little tune as I go!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,7)>Quando eu vou para um voo, eu gosto de tomar o meu tempo e murmurar um
Um pouco de música!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Ohhh... Huh. I don’t think I’ve ever flown like that before.
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,5)>Ohhh... Huh. Eu acho que nunca voei assim antes.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Hee hee... If you try it out, you might just see the appeal!
<$comeff(2,12)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>Here—this is how I hum: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Hum hum hum hummm... ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Se experimentares, pode ver o apelo!
<$comeff(2,12)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,8)>É assim que eu canto: <$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Hum, hum, hum...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>I think I feel ya! Somethin’ like this?!
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum! HUM! HUMMMMMM!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Eu acho que eu sinto você! Algo assim?!
<$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,9)>Hum, hum, hum!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>No, not like that! You need to be less forceful with it!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Like this—hum hum hum hummm... ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,5)>Não, assim não, tem de ser menos forte com isso!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Assim... hum hum hum hum hum...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Hum! Hum! Hum hummm...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,13)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,7)>Hum, hum, hum, hum...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Yes, that’s quite the improvement! But you’re still putting
too much force into it... <$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Try again!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,21)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Sim, isso é bastante a melhoria! Mas você ainda está colocando
muita força para isso... <$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,10)>Tenta outra vez!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Hum hum—
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Hold up. Why am I practicing my humming? I wanted to go
fly around...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,8)>Hum hum...
<$comeff(1,7)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,3)>Porque é que estou a praticar o meu zumbido?
Voa por aí...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>You can’t just stop midway through, <$cdef(27)><$cname(343)>! Let’s keep
at it!
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Hum hum hum hummm... ♪
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Você não pode simplesmente parar no meio do caminho, <$cdef(27)><$cname(343)>! Vamos manter
- Sim, senhor.
<$comeff(2,9)><$facial(2,4)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,9)>Hum, hum, hum...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,2)>*sigh*...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,17)><$facial(1,9)><$voicel(1,2)>*suspiro *...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,7)>What’s wrong, <$cdef(27)><$cname(339)></color>, dear? You look worried...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,5)><$motionoff(2,804)><$voicel(2,7)>O que está errado, <$cdef(27)><$cname(339)></color>Pareces preocupada...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Well, you see, I’m able to sense great disasters before
they happen.
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,4)>This ability has me feeling somewhat uneasy...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,805)><$voicel(1,5)>Bem, você vê, eu sou capaz de sentir grandes desastres antes
Acontecem.
<$comeff(1,7)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,4)>Esta habilidade faz-me sentir um pouco inquieto...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh, goodness! You mean something is going to happen?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(2,11)><$motion(2,662)><$voicel(2,9)>Meu Deus, quer dizer que vai acontecer alguma coisa?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Ah, no. I sense no such impending disaster at this time.<$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)>It’s more that I can’t help but worry sometimes. What if
something awful happens to this wonderful place that
<$cdef(27)> has worked so hard to make?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,4)><$motion(1,802)><$voicel(1,5)>Não, não sinto nenhum desastre iminente neste momento.<$motion(2,803)><$comeff(2,8)>
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,806)><$voicel(1,3)>É mais que eu não posso evitar de me preocupar às vezes. E se
Algo terrível acontece a este lugar maravilhoso que
<$cdef(27)> tem trabalhado tão duro para fazer?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Oh, my. Worrying without even sensing anything? I’m more
concerned about <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,8)>you burning yourself out, <$cdef(27)><$cname(339)>!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Why don’t you try taking it a little easier?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,801)><$voicel(2,7)>Nossa. Preocupar-se sem sentir nada? Sou mais
Preocupado com <$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,807)><$voicel(2,8)>está a queimar-te, <$cdef(27)><$cname(339)>!
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Por que você não tenta levar isso um pouco mais fácil?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Perhaps you’re right... Maybe I’m just overthinking.
How fun it would be if everyone thought like you.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,7)>Talvez você esteja certo... Talvez eu esteja apenas pensando demais.
Como seria divertido se todos pensassem como tu.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Oh! But if everyone were as carefree as me, <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,10)>we might all
crack under pressure and get nothing done!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Sometimes we need to be a bit of a worrywart about
important matters—like you are, <$cdef(27)><$cname(339)>, dear.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,5)><$motion(2,803)><$voicel(2,9)>Mas se todos fossem tão despreocupados como eu, <$comeff(2,4)><$motion(2,802)><$voicel(2,10)>todos nós podemos
Quebrem-se sob pressão e não façam nada!
<$comeff(2,10)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,7)>Às vezes, temos de nos preocupar com
assuntos importantes – como você é, <$cdef(27)><$cname(339)>, querido.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,9)><$motion(1,801)><$voicel(1,9)>Thank you for saying so. I feel much better about my way
of thinking now.
dialogues.pt_br:
